## History

Magog was one of the resident porcelain dogs at Patty's Place. He shared the hearth with his counterpart, Gog, serving as part of the home's decor while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her housemates celebrated the acceptance of her story sketch.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P21](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0021), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P23](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0023)_
